correctness.rationale: Adjacent inequality gives signs ±1 mod 3, and abab is exactly an alternating sign triple, so only boundary sign-runs may be singletons. An interior insertion replaces s by −s,−s, the unique possible replacement. A new alternating triple must use one member of the identical pair on its boundary, with two old signs on one side. Its forbidden positions are the second position of a noninitial run and the penultimate position of a nonterminal run; they coincide only for an internal run of length three. A singleton boundary run transfers its one obstruction from an internal replacement to an end insertion. A single run has none. Two deletions can yield the same source from a destination only if the intervening segment is constant, impossible here. Thus among m+4 candidates the loss for r≥2 is 2r−2−t_3, and the degree is m+6−2r+t_3. The boundary weights z^L u^(L−1) and internal weights z^L u^(L−2+[L=3]), plus the one-run term, yield the rational series with six labels per composition. For r≥2 the excess d−4 is at most m−2. The cases of excess zero or one use all minimal internal lengths and either both minimal endpoints or exactly one incremented endpoint; they give the stated parity and multiplicities. Keeping internal lengths two realizes the parity of m through m−2; one internal length three realizes the opposite parity from 2 (m odd) or 3 (m even) through m−3. This includes empty ranges at the smallest lengths. One run alone attains m+4. Independent enumeration of valid destinations and inverse deletion (python /workspace/reproductions/insertion.py) matched every coefficient for 3≤n≤15. The all-length result follows from the run proof, not the cutoff.

evidence: The substitution result uses the same sign-change representation, then partitions a length layer into Hamming-one components. Its stated component sizes do not determine insertion degree: at n=5 the words 01020 and 01201 both have Hamming-one degree two and lie in four-cycle components, yet their insertion degrees are four and eight, by direct letter/gap tests.

value.rationale: The complete local neighborhood distribution resolves a natural structural question for a word language used in tandem-duplication coding.
